name: english_physics
text: Force is measured in newtons. According to Newton's second law, force equals mass multiplied by acceleration. A force of one newton gives a mass of one kilogram an acceleration of one meter per second squared.

name: english_narrative
text: The rain stopped before sunrise. Anna opened the window and heard birds singing in the garden. She made a cup of tea, picked up her notebook, and began to write about the journey she had taken the previous summer.

name: chinese_science
text: 水受热后会蒸发成水蒸气。水蒸气上升并冷却，凝结成小水滴，形成云。云中的水滴聚集后落到地面，成为降雨。这些水流入河流和海洋，再次参与水循环。

name: rust_code
math
text: Two plus two equals four. Three multiplied by five equals fifteen. The square root of nine is three. A triangle has three sides, while a square has four equal sides.

name: reasoning
text: All mammals are animals. A dolphin is a mammal. Therefore, a dolphin is an animal. If every book on a shelf is blue and a dictionary is on that shelf, then the dictionary is blue.
